findings.value: A free-to-visit city farm on Goldsmiths Row, E2, with farmyard animals, a garden, school visits and room hire. It is run as a registered charity.

evidence.quote: Hackney City Farm is free to visit. As a small community charity

findings.value: The farm says it offers animal visits to children and grown-ups. Time Out says it draws locals and visitors alike.

evidence.quote: We offer children and grown-ups the opportunity to get up close to a range of farmyard animals.
providing a welcome dose of nature for locals and visitors alike

notes: The Time Out page's structured data gives a 2025-07-14 date, but its other dates are 2019; the same site-wide stamp appears on other Time Out pages. The farm's own home page says 'Pottery closed 'til Sept.' while the farmyard is open. That is a closure of one part of the site, not the venue, so no status is proposed. Web search budget ran out, so further press reviews were not checked.
